rules.name: Warlord
rules.description:
• If your Warlord dies all friendly Units within 8” must make a Panic Test (unless they are Immune to Panic).
• Every friendly Unit 8” from the Warlord may use his LD for Psychology Tests.

rules.name: Animal Control
rules.description:
Range: 26” and LoS
Level: 9
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 3
Description: Being able to converse with the beasts around him, the Keeper forces them to do his bidding. 
Effect: Cast on a model classified as an Animal that hasn't activated this turn. If cast successfully (the model can make a normal Spell Saving Roll) you gain control of that model until the end of this turn. If cast on a Cavalry model where the mount is treated as an Animal, control is gained of the animal only, not the rider.

rules.name: Animal Terror
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 8
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: Bestial manifestations echo in the mind of all animals close to the Keeper, causing them to scream in terror. 
Effect: Cast anytime during the turn. All models classified as Animals, no further than 6” from the Keeper, must take a Terror (2) test.

rules.name: Blood of a Totem
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 9
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 4
Description: Sometimes the Keeper can hear the voice of the Totem in his mind, forcing him to extreme feats of strength.
Effect: You increase your CC by 6 and gain the Mighty Blow Skill until the end of the turn.

rules.name: Fear of the Totem
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 9
Type: Spell
Bond Cost: 4  
Description: The Keeper is able, through mystical means, to project their impending doom at the claws of the Blood Totem.
Effect: You gain the Terror (3) Skill until the end of the game.

rules.name: Strength of theTotem
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 8
Type: Instant Spell
Bond Cost: 2
Description: Imbued with the strength of his Clan's Totem, the keeper strikes with a demonic fury.
Effect: Cast before you make an attack roll in Close Combat. You can use the Strength of your clan Totem in this round of combat.

rules.name: Transformation
rules.description:
Range: Self
Level: 10
Type: Ritual Spell
Bond Cost: 5*
Description: The symbiotic relationship between the Keeper and Blood Totem culminates with the beast taking over the flesh of the dwarf, spreading blood and carnage to the enemies of the Clan.
Effect: After successfully cast the Keeper is transformed into the Totem of his clan for two full turns before reverting back to his normal self. While transformed he is treated as a Blood Totem, with all the relevant Characteristics and Skills. At the end phase of the last turn he transforms back into the Keeper and may start his turn as normal. If the Keeper takes more Wounds, when in Blood Totem form, than he has as a Keeper, he will die when he transforms back! 
* You can Bond this Spell only when playing Army Battle Level or Grand Army Battle Level.
